about: idea-tobias's last live bullet, which the writer tagged #status/rejected, sits on the line directly above an empty '## Rejected' heading, with no blank line between them before or after the move (case 154 has blank lines). A reject unit moves it below the heading, same text. Line by line, the note can read as the bullet moving down past the heading or as the heading moving up past the bullet; only the first is the record's move. `record` must find the copy below the heading, at a place the snapshot can't account for, and pass to verifying. The unit is approved; `pointers` writes nothing (a reject gets no pointer), so b1-u1 stays approved with pointed_lines []. The real Edit guard gives [] (as its fixture 48 does). `act` goes straight to acted, and `close` puts the moved line on the handled list as `rejected`, pointer null. The log opens with 'Nothing needs you.' and holds only Rejected.
